messages:
Maya (AM): HealthBridge RFI dropped — they want a 3-week POC, EU data residency, SOC2 evidence, and per-request latency SLA. RFI link: <https://drive.redwood.com/attachments/hb-rfi-1.xlsx|hb-rfi-1.xlsx>
Rohit (SE): Quick read: scope = chat assist + embeddings search + semantic rerank. They asked about offline model tuning and private logs.
Diego (Infra): EU-hosting OK. For 3-week POC I'd suggest a dedicated small pool (1xA100) + warm standby. note: quantized LLMs reduce mem and help latency.
Hannah (Security): Security questionnaire flagged: data residency, audit log retention, breach notification timeline, vuln scanning cadence. Need to know if customers will send PHI.
Nora (Pricing): Baseline POC pricing: hosted usage + dedicated reserve. draft: $6k pro-rated for reserve, $0.0011/token gen. Add 24/7 on-call for PoC = $1.2k/week.
Maya (AM): They estimated 3M tokens/day average, spikes to 8M. please size accordingly.
Rohit (SE): Proposal: primary model redwood-llama-13b-quant, fallback redwood-llama-7b. For embeddings, recommend batch_size 128 and cache top-k prefixes. Also need to capture SSO and KMS ARNs.
Diego (Infra): sample deploy manifest:
```
deployment_name: hb-poc-eu
pool: dedicated-eu-small
instance_count: 2
model: redwood-llama-13b-quant
autoscale:
  min: 1
  max: 3
  target_rps: 90
```
Use prefix/KV cache enabled.
Hannah (Security): We support customer-managed KMS for hosted API and full HSM on Private. Our default audit logs retention is 90 days in EU; we can extend to 365 on request. I'll attach SOC2 and penetration test summary.
rfi-bot: HealthBridge RFI uploaded: hb-rfi-1.xlsx (size: 390KB)
Eli (Legal): They included a data escrow clause and a GDPR data processing addendum with additional subprocessors. I'll need the specific clause numbers — Maya, can you point me to them in the sheet?
Maya (AM): See sheet tab 'Contract' rows 42-59. Also they asked for an indemnity cap aligned to ARR.
Nora (Pricing): Given token volumes, recommend a 4-week commitment discounted at 15% for PoC conversions. I'll add a breakout by tokens/day and by route (chat vs embeddings).
Rohit (SE): Performance test command for synthetic load:
```
./loadgen --model redwood-llama-13b-quant --qps 100 --seq 512 --concurrency 8
```
We'll run inside eu-west-1 with burst to simulate spikes.
Diego (Infra): On SLO: 200ms end-to-end median for 13b quant might be reachable with colocated infra and low seq lengths, but 95p will be higher. Recommend offering 250ms median and commit to a fallback policy to smaller model to preserve SLA.
Hannah (Security): Action: I'll complete the security questionnaire draft by EOD and flag any 'no' answers. Need contact for their compliance: compliance@healthbridge.ai.
Eli (Legal): I'll review the escrow/indemnity language and propose redlines by tomorrow morning.
Maya (AM): Action items: 1) Rohit to update capability matrix with model options + perf notes (ETA 4h). 2) Nora to send detailed pro-rated pricing sheet (ETA 2h). 3) Diego to produce infra manifest and perf plan (ETA 6h). 4) Hannah to draft security answers (ETA EOD). 5) Eli to review contract asks (ETA next AM).
Rohit (SE): I'll also include a short section on 'no-code' eval steps so their product team can run tests without infra changes.
Nora (Pricing): One Q: do we include private deployment upfront cost in the PoC quote or present it as optional?
Maya (AM): Present it optional but include a 'delta' sheet. They specifically asked about on-prem/hsm pricing so include it.
Diego (Infra): Note: if PHI is in scope we should push for Private deployment or strict contractual controls. Hannah, confirm PHI stance with them.
Hannah (Security): I'll ask compliance contact. tagging @Maya to follow up.
Maya (AM): Scheduling internal review at 3pm PST to assemble the response. I'll compile RFI answers + capability matrix + pricing and aim to send consolidated response by tomorrow COB.
Rohit (SE): ack.
Nora (Pricing): ack.
Diego (Infra): ack.
Hannah (Security): ack.
Eli (Legal): ack.
